# Akram Sabry — Food Safety & Quality

Official website: https://akram-sabry.github.io/

Akram Sabry is a Food Safety & Quality Management Specialist, consultant, trainer and Lead Auditor working in food quality, food safety systems, auditing, factory readiness and professional training.

Core areas:
- HACCP and Food Safety
- ISO 22000 and ISO 9001
- BRCGS Food Safety and audit readiness
- Rainforest Alliance supply-chain requirements
- NFSA White List readiness
- Internal and supplier audits
- CAPA, risk assessment and root-cause analysis
- GMP/GHP and documentation control
- Food safety and quality training

Contact:
- WhatsApp/Phone: +201155780461
- Email: akramsabry257@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/akram-sabry-a543a3239/
